items.headline: Sources: QB Maddux Madsen out vs. Rams, Boise State targets return next week
items.description: Boise State quarterback Maddux Madsen (knee) will not play at Colorado State, with the Broncos expecting him to return next week, sources told ESPN. Max Cutforth is set to start in Madsen's place.
